Amb una capacitat per a aproximadament 70 comensals al seu interior i 16 a la seva terrassa, aquest restaurant en funcionament ha aconseguit generar una facturació anual d'uns impressionants 600.000€. Imagina el potencial que té per créixer encara més!

El traspàs es realitza per 475.000€, i el lloguer mensual és de 3.300€ més impostos. A més, existeix la possibilitat de signar un contracte d'arrendament de fins a 15 anys, proporcionant-te estabilitat i l'oportunitat d'establir un negoci exitós a llarg termini.

REF: 6596408

Inmolaya exclusively presents! Opportunity to transfer a restaurant in Barcelona in a privileged location next to the famous Ramblas and the iconic Boqueria Market. If you are looking for a business in a tourist area with great activity, this is your chance!

This bright corner restaurant has a charming terrace with 4 tables and 16 chairs, perfect for enjoying the Mediterranean climate and attracting passers-by. The premises have been renovated and offer 150m2 distributed over 2 floors, providing a cozy and versatile space.

With a capacity for approximately 70 diners inside and 16 on its terrace, this operating restaurant has managed to generate an annual turnover of an impressive €600,000. Imagine the potential it has to grow even more!

The transfer is made for €475,000, and the monthly rent is €3,300 plus taxes. In addition, there is the possibility of signing a lease of up to 15 years, providing you with stability and the opportunity to establish a successful long-term business.

Don't miss the chance to own this restaurant in a dream location! Contact us right now for more information and to arrange a visit. Inmolaya is here to help you make your business dreams come true. Don't miss this unique opportunity!
